categories.title: Guide
categories.blurb: How Essence & Earth works, from your first essence to a farm of diamonds.

entries.name: Getting started
entries.summary: Find Terra Essence, upgrade it, and plant your first resource crop.

blocks.html: Essence & Earth lets you grow resources. Every crop starts as essence: you combine essence with the resource you want, plant the seeds, and harvest essence that crafts back into that resource.
Mine Essence Ore underground, or collect Terra Essence from mobs, grass and ripe vanilla crops. Once you have a little, the Terra crop gives you a steady supply.

items.name: Essence Ore
items.sub: Underground, y -32 to 64: 2–4 each

items.name: Mobs
items.sub: Most mobs: 20% chance

items.name: Short Grass
items.sub: Grass and ferns: 20% chance

items.name: Wheat Crops
items.sub: Ripe wheat, carrots, potatoes, beetroot: 15% chance

items.name: Terra Crop
items.sub: 1 to 3 per ripe harvest on average, by farmland tier

blocks.html: Four essence of one tier craft one of the next: Terra → Aqua → Ignis → Aether → Astra. Each crop needs the essence of its tier.
Surround wheat seeds with four tier essence and four of the resource. Plant the seeds on any farmland and wait. Essence farmland gives extra drops, and growth accelerators speed them up.
A ripe crop drops 1 of its essence and its seed back. Each crop page shows the recipe that turns its essence into the resource.

facts: 4 stages, about 43% chance per random tick
1 essence and 1 seed, with extras on essence farmland

blocks.html: On any essence farmland, a ripe crop has a 10% chance of a second essence and a 10% chance of a second seed. If the farmland matches the crop's tier, each rises to 20%. On vanilla farmland there are no extras.
Place growth accelerators below a crop. Each gives it an extra growth chance about every 30 seconds, so more means faster.

categories.title: Essence farmland
categories.blurb: Farmland that never dries out and gives ripe crops a chance of a second essence and seed.

entries.name: Terra Farmland
entries.summary: Best for tier 1 crops: 20% chance of each extra.

facts: 20% chance of a second essence, and of a second seed
1 Terra Essence per harvest on average

blocks.html: Use one Terra Essence on placed farmland, or craft one dirt and one Terra Essence to make 1. Using it on farmland of another tier swaps the tier, with a 25% chance of getting one of the old essence back.

categories.title: Growth accelerators
categories.blurb: Blocks that go below a crop and make it grow faster. Higher tiers reach further.

entries.name: Terra Growth Accelerator
entries.summary: Reaches a crop up to 9 blocks away.

facts: 1 extra growth chance about every 30 seconds
In about 3.5 minutes with one accelerator
Anywhere below the crop, with room for the farmland

blocks.html: Every tier grows crops at the same speed, and higher tiers only reach further. Each accelerator works on its own, so more of them means faster, and it works on the first crop above it, through any blocks in between.
Four Terra Essence, four stone and one Terra Gemstone make 3.

categories.title: Tools
categories.blurb: A sickle that harvests 3×3 and a hoe that replants as it harvests.

entries.name: Essence Sickle
entries.summary: Harvests every ripe crop in a 3×3.

facts: Essence crops, wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroot

blocks.html: Breaking a ripe crop also harvests every ripe crop around it. Unripe crops are left alone, and the sickle won't break one even if you hit it directly. Farmland bonus essence and second seeds work as normal.

entries.name: Essence Hoe
entries.summary: Right-click a ripe crop to harvest and replant it.

facts: Essence crops, wheat, carrots, potatoes and beetroot

blocks.html: The crop drops as normal and restarts at its first stage. The replant takes one seed from the drops, so it costs the same as replanting by hand. The hoe doesn't till dirt.
